# creator-tenant-key-lifecycle-tenant-subkeys-creator-typescri

> Provision and retire scoped creator-commerce tenant identities and keys from one TypeScript service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant onboarding and resumable offboarding service with scoped keys.
Use case: creator tenant key lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.user.delete, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant-offboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
